verdict.rationale: Synthesia publishes a first-party API reference at docs.synthesia.io/reference. It covers the Video, Upload, Billing and Localization APIs, with a quickstart describing request and response behavior, so a reference to explore exists. The evidence never shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code samples in the reference, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Video API — generate finished video files: scripted avatar videos, dubbing, translation, and templates at scale.
Upload API (V2) — upload your own image/video assets or custom script audio (e.g. your own text-to-speech) for use when creating Video API videos.
the response includes then a time-limited download link in the `download` attribute, use this link to download the video as an `.mp4`
